searched.title: Bambu Lab US store product page: E3D High Flow ObXidian™ Hotend
searched.note: The P0 corpus copy, parsed with the package (extractPage + buildImportPayload, manifest row). Product Specifications: Max. Printing Temp. 300 ℃, Color Black, Packaging Weight 0.045 kg, Packaging Size 60*60*30 mm (all kept by the deterministic layer). In the Box: one item. No product dimensions, net weight, electrical value, filament diameter or filament-compatibility table. "60% more flow rate" / "60% increase in volumetric flow rate" is a relative marketing claim with no baseline or absolute figure, so no motion.max_flow value is taken.

searched.title: Introduction to Bambu Nozzles | Bambu Lab Wiki
searched.note: Read in full from the cached HTML (the cached .txt omits the tab panels). The "E3D High Flow ObXidian™ Hotend" panel gives Compatibility, Max. Printing Temp 300 ℃ and Size 0.4mm/ 0.6mm; the compatibility table row gives X1C, P1P, P1S. No dimensions, weight, flow figure, electrical value or In the Box list for this product. The "Complete hotend" / "Nozzle only" explanation sits in the separate X1/P1 Series Nozzle panel and is not applied to this product's Hotend Type values. The silicone-sock 300°C ratings belong to those separate products.

searched.title: Manually Adjust System to E3D HF ObXidian™ 0.4/0.6mm Preset | Bambu Lab Wiki
searched.note: Linked from the store page. A preset-tuning guide: per filament and hotend diameter it lists process and filament settings and a pressure-advance K value; none maps to a registry key, and the table lists only the filaments whose settings change, so no filament-compatibility relation is derived from it. It applies to X1C/P1S/P1P and advises against high-temperature materials on the P1P (kept as a note on the P1P relation). No product dimension, weight, temperature or flow figure.

searched.title: Filament guide - Printer, Nozzle, AMS, Build Plate, Glue Compatibility and Required Parameters | Bambu Lab Wiki
searched.note: A general guide for every Bambu nozzle. Its Nozzle table has generic "0.4 / 0.6 mm High flow nozzle" columns but never names the E3D ObXidian hotend, so none of its rows is stored for this product. Its nozzle temperatures are per filament, not values of this hotend.

specs.source_title: Introduction to Bambu Nozzles | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.locator: Types › E3D High Flow ObXidian™ Hotend panel › paragraph 1
specs.quote: This hotend can provide 60% more flow rate, features the signature ObXidian™ hardened nozzle, and E3DLC™ coating for excellent durability.
specs.note: From product prose, so unverified (§C.6). The source names the nozzle "ObXidian™ hardened" but never says "hardened steel", so no steel grade is stated. The store page description carries the same sentence. Fills the store page's not_found row.

specs.value: E3DLC™ coating: a thin, diamond-like layer applied via plasma (non-stick)
specs.source_title: E3D High Flow ObXidian™ Hotend (store page)
specs.locator: Description › "Non-Stick Coating, Reduce the Risk of Nozzle Blobbing" › paragraph 1
specs.quote: The E3DLC™ coating is a thin, diamond-like layer applied via plasma, creating an ultra-smooth surface that significantly reduces plastic build-up on the nozzle.
specs.note: From product prose, so unverified (§C.6). The nozzles wiki panel names the same coating ("E3DLC™ coating for excellent durability"). No number is taken from this prose.

specs.source_title: Introduction to Bambu Nozzles | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.locator: Size › table › row "0.4 mm" › Layer heights
specs.quote: 0.1 mm to 0.3 mm (25-75% of nozzle diameter), with 0.2 mm being standard.
specs.note: General guidance of the wiki's nozzle Size table for every Bambu nozzle of this diameter, not a specification published for this product; kept unverified. Scoped to this page's Nozzle Diameter value by its diameter. The E3D preset wiki adds that its 0.4 mm process parameters fit only the "0.2 mm standard" layer-height setting.

specs.source_title: Introduction to Bambu Nozzles | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.locator: Size › table › row "0.6 mm" › Layer heights
specs.quote: 0.15 mm to 0.45 mm (25-75% of nozzle diameter), with 0.3-0.4 mm being common.
specs.note: General guidance of the wiki's nozzle Size table for every Bambu nozzle of this diameter, not a specification published for this product; kept unverified. Scoped to this page's Nozzle Diameter value by its diameter. The E3D preset wiki adds that its 0.6 mm process parameters fit only the "0.3 mm standard" layer-height setting.
